# Maternity assessment beds

!!! info "Definition"
    A maternity assessment bed is a hospital bed used for the assessment, monitoring and short-term care of pregnant or postnatal patients before admission, transfer or discharge decisions are made.

## Activity classification

A maternity spell may require capacity for assessment, delivery and postnatal care across different functional areas. This calculation estimates assessment-bed requirements.

Activity is limited to zero-day maternity spells without a recorded birth event.

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

Convert qualifying zero-day maternity spells into occupancy hours using the assumed length of stay.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Occupancy hours}
    =
    \text{Zero-day maternity spells}
    \times
    \frac{\text{Zero-day length of stay (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of maternity assessment beds by dividing occupancy hours by the product of the service's annual operational hours and the assumed occupancy rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \begin{aligned}
    &\text{Required maternity assessment beds} \\
    &=
    \frac{\text{Occupancy hours}}
    {\text{Annual operational hours} \times \text{Occupancy rate}}
    \end{aligned}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All groups | Length of stay | Pathway |
| All groups | Occupancy rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |


??? info "Technical details"
    **Capacity outputs**

    * `MATERNITY_ASSESSMENT_BEDS`

    **Conversion archetype:** recovery occupancy · `FRM_RECOVERY_OCCUPANCY`

    **Operational constraint:** temporary occupancy with intra-day turnover

    **Workload object:** `occupancy_hours`

    **Classification expressions**

    | Subgroup | Expression |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_ZERO_LOS` AND `CLASS_NO_BIRTH_EVENT`) |

    **Classification definitions**

    | ID | Definition | Rule |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `CLASS_MATERNITY` | Maternity admissions | (admimeth starts with 3 OR tretspef IN (501, 560)) AND sex = "2" AND age BETWEEN 13 AND 55 |
    | `CLASS_ZERO_LOS` | Zero day length-of-stay spells | speldur = 0 |
    | `CLASS_NO_BIRTH_EVENT` | No birth event recorded | Not documented |

    **Classification notes**

    * `CLASS_MATERNITY`: See the Demand Model definition of maternity activity: https://connect.strategyunitwm.nhs.uk/nhp/project_information/data_extraction/inpatients.html#group

    **Assumption references**

    | Subgroup | Assumption ID |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | `MATERNITY_ASSESSMENT_ZERO_DAY_LOS` |
    | All groups | `MATERNITY_ASSESSMENT_OCC` |
    | All groups | `MATERNITY_ASSESSMENT_ANNUAL_OPERATIONAL_HOURS` |
